evidence: Workbook check 2: 'Keeps an authentic human voice (casual/terse is good); not robotic, over-polished, or LLM-generated prose.' Skill quality-checks.md check 2 defects: 'uniform cadence, marketing gloss ("seamless", "robust", "delve"), perfectly parallel bullets, or a voice that changes between instruction.md and the notes'. task/instruction.md (5 lines, three short paragraphs) is first person, contracted and anecdotal: line 1 'I'd like a small local playground...' and 'The editor itself matters: I often paste a long one-line experiment, format it, make changes in several places, and then run it beside the source.'; line 3 ends with the terse 'there is no starter app to finish.' Sentence lengths vary and there are no bullets, headings, numbered acceptance lists or spec tables. Mechanical scan of instruction.md and all six notes: zero hits for seamless/robust/delve/leverage/comprehensive/intuitive/ensure/utilize/streamline/powerful, zero em or en dashes, zero bullet or numbered-list lines. The same first-person owner continues into the notes, so the voice does not switch persona: overview.md:3 'stays current in each of them while I work'; behaviour.md:11 'That refresh must not touch what I'm doing' and 'say so and keep my draft; do not load the newer revision over my work'; ui.md:3 'as long as the source I see is drawn by your own surface' and 'Don't use a textarea...'; ui.md:9 'whichever you prefer'. Cadence in the notes is uneven rather than uniform, with short sentences beside long ones (behaviour.md:5 'A restored picture may be static.'; ui.md:11 'Navigation wraps at the ends.'; security.md:5 'Save source as text.'). Residual observations that do not reach a defect under this row: (a) the register hardens from the casual brief into contract prose in the notes, with 21 uses of 'must' across them (10 in behaviour.md) and only three contractions outside instruction.md, e.g. behaviour.md:3 'show a useful error message there with a one-based line number for a thrown error, including an error inside a complete HTML file, counted from the first line of that file, and a Promise rejection that nothing handles; the message is the text of the Error or rejected value, not an empty object' and integration.md:11 'Symbolic links are unsupported except links under /app/node_modules whose resolved targets also stay under /app/node_modules.'; these read as clauses accreted across repair rounds, precise rather than glossy; (b) integration.md is plural ('How we start the app', 'We start it with node /app/server.js') while the brief and other notes are singular 'I'; plausible as owner versus ops but slightly inconsistent; (c) policy.md and security.md contain no first person at all; (d) instruction.md:3 '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope' is mildly jargon-like for a casual requester. None of these is marketing gloss, uniform cadence, parallel bullets or a change of persona, and the row is scoped to instruction.md being authentic rather than robotic. The template instruction.md is only a CHANGE_ME stub and imposes no voice. No runtime evidence is required for this row; the scripted golden and earlier-candidate hosted run do not measure voice.
